accepted_mc2: unchanged MC2-E (V3.2D/E science frozen; no rho/anchor/dynamics/variance change)

api_rules.no_runtime_network: runtime consumes local derived status artifacts only; no web fetch at request time

coverage_accounting_rules.attribution: every newly eligible checkpoint must have every stale offender Retired=True at T under v3.2j-driver-status-v1; new_eligible == fully_resolved_stale_only_checkpoints subject to all other blockers; no unexplained growth
coverage_accounting_rules.denominator: frozen 9644-checkpoint catalogue (results/v3/v3_2f/coverage_opportunity_raw.json); population fixed before source download
coverage_accounting_rules.partial_field: a checkpoint with even one unresolved stale offender stays refused; no partial cleaning

failure_policy: fail closed: artifact absent / hash mismatch / unknown schema / race unavailable -> do not infer retirement; existing V3.2C eligibility applies; no network fallback

parity_rules.corpus: V3.2F 50-checkpoint dry-green corpus 7ae97c3c; all previously supported states must remain bit-exact (field + RNG); any difference STOPs J

season_acceptance_criteria.reject_condition: if a season materially changes schema/meaning versus the frozen contract, that season is rejected from admission until understood; partial-season admission is a valid outcome
season_acceptance_criteria.require: each season 2018..2024 audited independently; 2018 semantics never assumed to transfer

source_family: official Formula 1 live-timing static TimingData.jsonStream deltas (same family as V3.2I local cache)

state_reconstruction_semantics.missing_key: preserve previous Retired state; missing key is never False
state_reconstruction_semantics.ordering: chronological delta order; duplicate/tied timestamps resolved deterministically (first-seen wins)
state_reconstruction_semantics.query: status(T) = latest causally observed Retired value with delta timestamp <= T; no nearest-future lookup; never inspect deltas > T
state_reconstruction_semantics.sticky_forbidden: first Retired=True is NOT terminal; True->False clearings must take effect; no permanent driver blacklist

transient_firewall: every V3.2C/G transient-absence driver (disappears then returns) must NOT be excluded unless Retired=True at that exact T; clearings must restore later checkpoints
unknown_semantics: absence != retirement; Stopped != retirement; InPit != retirement; PitOut != active proof; position_null != retirement; final DNF != retirement; unknown remains unknown and never becomes active

url_session_resolution_rules.expected_count: 104 race streams (21+17+22+22+22) derived from frozen replay catalogue rounds, NOT from download success
url_session_resolution_rules.round_mapping: round ordinal rNN (1-indexed) maps to Nth sorted event dir under data/raw/fastf1_cache/{season}/ (verified against D9 race_id counts)

v3_2i_parent: V3.2I verdict LOCAL_RAW_STATUS_SOURCE PARTIALLY VIABLE; Retired is current-state (true->false measured, Ricciardo Belgium 2018); partial projection 2305 -> 2685 (+380, stale-only, 2018+2024 local)

winner_firewall.require: reconstruct Retired(T) across all relevant replay checkpoints; no premature retirement exclusion; every eventual winner with any Retired=True event in 2018-2024 evaluated; any unexplained pre-finish winner exclusion BLOCKs J
